# occupation classification

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:occupationClassification`](gmeow-occupationClassification.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/occupationClassification>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An external classification code for an occupation (ESCO, SOC, O*NET, ISCO, NOC). Non-functional — an occupation may carry codes from several schemes. The scheme is solver-side; the literal is the raw code value ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Occupation`](../classes/gmeow-Occupation.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:occupationClassification`](gmeow-occupationClassification.md) from [`gmeow:Occupation`](../classes/gmeow-Occupation.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach an external occupation-classification code (ESCO, SOC, O*NET, ISCO, NOC) to a [`gmeow:Occupation`](../classes/gmeow-Occupation.md) as a raw literal — the cross-walk handle a solver resolves to a scheme ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid trying to encode the scheme in the property or value (the scheme is solver-side; keep the literal the raw code) and avoid forcing one code — an occupation legitimately carries codes from several schemes at once.

### How to use

- State the bare code string per scheme on the occupation; let the solver layer map each literal to its classification scheme rather than over-typing the value here ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

- ex:nurse [`gmeow:occupationClassification`](gmeow-occupationClassification.md) "29-1141".
